# authsignal_push_authenticator_configuration (Resource)

Manages the tenant's push authenticator configuration. Destroying the resource deletes the configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "fcm_service_account_key" {
  type      = string
  ephemeral = true
  sensitive = true
}

resource "authsignal_push_authenticator_configuration" "push" {
  push_provider = "FIREBASE"

  fcm_credentials = {
    service_account_key = var.fcm_service_account_key
  }

  fcm_credentials_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `push_provider` (String) Push delivery provider. `DEFAULT` supports APNs and Firebase; `WEBHOOK` requires `webhook_url`. One of `DEFAULT`, `FIREBASE`, `WEBHOOK`.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `apns_credentials` (Attributes) Apple Push Notification service credentials. Usable when `push_provider` is `DEFAULT`, which delivers to Apple devices through APNs and to Android devices through Firebase. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apns_credentials))
- `apns_credentials_version` (String) Credential rotation marker for `apns_credentials`. Change it to resend the credentials. Use an opaque counter or date, never a secret.
- `app_attestation_failure_mode` (String) What happens when app attestation fails. Applies only while `require_app_attestation` is true. `BLOCK` refuses the challenge; `ALLOW_WITH_WARNING` allows it and flags it.
- `credential_lifetime_in_minutes` (Number) Push credential lifetime in minutes. Must be between 0 and 525600.
- `fcm_credentials` (Attributes, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Firebase Cloud Messaging credentials. Required for `FIREBASE` and supported for `DEFAULT`. Derived project and client email values are available as `fcm_project_id` and `fcm_client_email`. This block is entirely write-only, so `fcm_credentials_version` is required when it is set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fcm_credentials))
- `fcm_credentials_version` (String) Credential rotation marker for `fcm_credentials`. Change it to resend the credentials. Use an opaque counter or date, never a secret.
- `is_active` (Boolean)
- `require_app_attestation` (Boolean) Whether the app must attest its integrity before a push challenge is accepted. `app_attestation_failure_mode` decides what happens when attestation fails.
- `sending_rate_limit_configurations` (Attributes List) Notification delivery limits. All configured limits apply. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sending_rate_limit_configurations))
- `webhook_url` (String) HTTPS delivery endpoint. Required for `WEBHOOK` and rejected for other providers. Switching providers clears it.

### Read-Only

- `authenticator_id` (String)
- `fcm_client_email` (String) The Firebase client email, read back from the service account key.
- `fcm_project_id` (String) The Firebase project id, read back from the service account key.
- `verification_method` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--apns_credentials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `apns_credentials`

Required:

- `bundle_id` (String) Bundle ID of the app receiving the notification.
- `key_id` (String) ID of the APNs signing key.
- `team_id` (String) Apple developer team ID.

Optional:

- `private_key` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) APNs signing key (.p8 contents). Requires Terraform 1.11 or later; supply it through an ephemeral, sensitive variable.
- `sandbox` (Boolean) Whether notifications go to the APNs sandbox rather than production.


<a id="nestedatt--fcm_credentials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fcm_credentials`

Optional:

- `service_account_key` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Service account key as JSON. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later; supply it through an ephemeral, sensitive variable.


<a id="nestedatt--sending_rate_limit_configurations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sending_rate_limit_configurations`

Required:

- `rate_limit` (Number) Maximum attempts in the window. Must be between 1 and 100.
- `window_in_minutes` (Number) Window length in minutes. Must be between 1 and 1440; fractional values are supported.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import authsignal_push_authenticator_configuration.push push
```
